articles.title: HNLC questions civilian safety amid military installations in Shillong
articles.summary: The proscribed Hynniewtrep National Liberation Council (HNLC) has raised significant concerns regarding the strategic placement of major military installations within civilian areas. This issue highlights ongoing internal security challenges and the delicate balance between defence infrastructure and local community welfare in conflict-affected regions within the nation, a critical topic for SSB aspirants.
